text:
Liam (CEO): Heads up — all-hands Monday 9:30am PT in Main Room. Expect ~45 min. Well record and post slides. Quick ask: please drop one question you want answered by EOD Sun. :spiral_calendar:

Priya (VP Product): Draft agenda: 1) CEO update + hiring snapshot (Liam) 2) Product demo: dynamic batching A/B results (Priya) 3) Security & compliance: audit logging and retention changes (Nora/Elena) 4) Incident recap: customer-facing impact and learnings (Elena) 5) Roadmap callouts + Q&A (open mic).

Priya (VP Product): Demo slots: if you want a 4-min slot, reply with "demo" and a 1-line summary. We'll pick up to 3. Upload a 2-slide PDF to the folder by Sun 11pm PT. Link: https://redwood.internal/allhands/mar-2026-slides

Nora (CTO): Policy note teaser: we'll enable audit-mode for telemetry on Apr 10: `redwood.telemetry.audit_mode=on` which logs model selection and routing metadata for 180 days. Dedicated customers can request custom retention. More on slide 7.

Elena (SRE): Incident teaser: last week we saw a brief upload storm during a canary push that increased tail latency and triggered autoscaling noise. No data leak; some user requests timed out. We'll run through root cause and the mitigations we implemented. Postmortem draft in #postmortems.

Sarah (People Ops): Logistics: hybrid-friendly time, please RSVP if you're joining from an office so we can order coffee and dials. If youd like to submit anonymous questions, use this form: https://forms.redwood/ah-questions (closed Mon 8am).

ops-bot: Reminder: add one question by EOD Sun to be eligible for live ask.

(After all-hands)

ops-bot: Recording + slides posted: https://redwood.internal/recordings/allhands-2432104322-2026-04-06.mp4 | https://redwood.internal/allhands/mar-2026-final.pdf

Liam (CEO): Thanks for joining. High-level takeaways: hiring focus on infra and sales, monthly revenue growth +12%, +2 new partnerships launching next quarter.

Priya (VP Product): Product highlight: dynamic batching A/B reduced median cost-per-token by ~8% on chat workloads with no QoE regression. Next steps: expand to 30% traffic and monitor prompts with eval harness.

Nora (CTO): Policy/conformance: audit_mode enabled for hosted default next month; retention set to 180 days. Action: Security & Legal will publish an FAQ and opt-out process for Dedicated by EOD Thu.

Elena (SRE): Incident summary: upload storm during canary caused 95th percentile latency spike in one region for ~20m. Root cause: rate-limiter misconfiguration + canary traffic shaping. Fixes: corrected limiter config, added circuit-breaker for ingress, improved canary throttling. Alerts added to detect similar spikes.

Liam (CEO): Customer-facing blurb for comms: "We briefly impacted request availability for a subset of users during an internal canary. No customer data was compromised. Our team restored normal service and implemented safeguards to prevent recurrence." Approve?

Priya (VP Product): Approved. Add a sentence about ongoing monitoring and the upcoming increase in canary coverage.

Elena (SRE): Approved. Also add: "We notified affected customers and offered 1:1 follow-up where needed."

Sarah (People Ops): Hiring note: job links and referral bonuses posted here: https://jobs.redwood/careers. Engineering hiring is prioritized; please refer candidates by end of month.

Priya (VP Product): Action items recap: - Eng leads: rollout schedule for dynamic batching expansion in #eng-releases by Fri - Security: publish audit_mode FAQ by Thu - SRE: finalize postmortem and mark follow-ups (tickets created).

Liam (CEO): Closing: next all-hands in 6 weeks. If we missed your question, DM me or Priya and we'll follow up on the record. Great session — thanks everyone. :clap:
